title: res.ok vs throw

blocks.md:
## 404 does not throw

The app stub answers `/missing` with status 404. `fetch` still resolves. `res.ok` is false. You throw *if you choose* after you look.

Print `ok` for `/beacons.json` and teach `read()` to throw when `!res.ok`.

choices.md: Resolves to a response with status 404

blocks.promptMd: > `read("/beacons.json")` returns parsed JSON and prints `true` (`ok` field). Hidden: `/missing` throws.

description: A missing page is still a response. Only a broken network throws.
